create.name: Bālasāgrāma (Rādhānagara)
create.location: Ten miles east of Rāmapura Hāṭa (Rampurhat)
create.about: The residence of Śrī Mīnaketana Rāmadāsa, of Nityānanda's branch.
create.source: Śrī Navadvīpa-dhāma (Bhaktivedānta Nārāyaṇa Gosvāmī Mahārāja), p. 206

create.name: Benāpola
create.about: Here Śrī Haridāsa Ṭhākura chanted 300,000 holy names daily; his bhajana-kuñja is here. The prostitute Lakṣahīrā, sent by Rāmacandra Khān to make him fall, heard his chanting for three nights, was purified and was initiated by him.

create.name: Budhuī-pāḍā
create.location: Now under the waters of the Gaṅgā; its people moved to Naiyālisa-pāḍā
create.about: Hemalatā-devī, Śrīnivāsa Ācārya's eldest daughter, was married here to Gopījana-vallabha, son of Rāmakiśana Caṭṭarāja. Her disciple Yadunandana dāsa, translator of many Vaiṣṇava books, also lived here. Her Gopāla deity is now worshipped in Yājīgrāma.

create.name: Cākadaha
create.about: The residence and samādhi of Śrī Maheśa Paṇḍita, one of the twelve gopālas of Nityānanda's branch (Udāra Gopāla in Vraja); deities said to be installed by him. Pradyumna killed Śambarāsura here, so it is also called Pradyumna-nagara.

create.name: Cāṅdapāḍā
create.location: Eight miles northeast of Murśidābād station
create.about: Birthplace of Śrī Subuddhi Rāya. When the Muslim governor made him lose his caste, Mahāprabhu told him to chant the holy name and go to Mathurā-Vṛndāvana, where he stayed and became a great saint.

create.name: Cāndapura
create.about: The residence of Śrī Yadunandana Ācārya, guru of Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī and dear friend of Haridāsa Ṭhākura.

create.name: Cāṭigrāma
create.location: A village in the Caṭṭagrāma district
create.about: Birthplace of Mahāprabhu's associates Śrī Puṇḍarīka Vidyānidhi, Śrī Caitanya Vallabha, Śrī Vāsudeva Datta and Śrī Mukunda Datta. Puṇḍarīka was the zamindar of Candraśālā.

create.name: Chatrabhoga
create.location: Four miles south of Jayanagara-Majilapura station, Thānā Mathurāpura (coordinates approximate)
create.about: In Mahāprabhu's time the Gaṅgā met the ocean here in hundreds of branches; He passed through on His way to Purī. Śrīla Bhaktisiddhānta Sarasvatī Ṭhākura installed His footprints (pāda-pīṭha) here. Nearby are Cakra-tīrtha and the tīrtha of Ambuliṅga.

create.name: Chuṅchurā
create.about: In Pañcānana-talā (Kāmārapāḍā market) is Śrī Śyāmasundara, the family deity of Raghunātha dāsa Gosvāmī, hidden here by his father Govardhana Majumadāra when Muslims troubled Saptagrāma. In the Śrī Uddhāraṇa Gauḍīya Maṭha (Caumāthā) are the Gaura-Nityānanda deities once worshipped by Śrīvāsa Paṇḍita in Kumārahaṭṭa.

create.name: Denuḍa
create.about: Birthplace of Śrī Keśava Bhāratī, Mahāprabhu's sannyāsa-guru. Śrī Vṛndāvana dāsa Ṭhākura wrote the Caitanya-bhāgavata here, in the home of his maternal uncle, and installed Nitāī-Gaura. Gadādhara Paṇḍita's handwritten Bhāgavatam, with words explained by Mahāprabhu Himself, is kept here.

create.name: Devagrāma
create.about: Birthplace of Śrīla Viśvanātha Cakravartī Ṭhākura (1654), son of Rāma-nārāyaṇa Cakravartī; he had his first schooling here and studied the bhakti-śāstras in Saidābāda.

create.name: Ḍhākā (Śrī Ḍhākeśvarī Pīṭha)
create.about: Śrī Vīracandra Prabhu asked the Nawab here for the carved stone on the tower of his palace and made from it a deity of Śrī Śyāmasundara; he preached bhakti in this region.

create.name: Ḍhākā-dakṣiṇa
create.about: Birthplace of Śrī Jagannātha Miśra, Mahāprabhu's father, and of his father Śrī Upendra Miśra; Mahāprabhu came here to meet His paternal grandmother. Also called Gupta-vṛndāvana.

create.name: Guptipāḍā
create.about: The residence of Śrī Vakreśvara Paṇḍita, whom Mahāprabhu entrusted with the service of the Rādhā-kānta Maṭha and the Gambhīrā in Kāśī Miśra's house in Purī.

create.name: Kāgaja Pukuriyā
create.about: Home of the wicked Rāmacandra Khān, who sent Lakṣahīrā to disturb Haridāsa Ṭhākura; she became a great Vaiṣṇavī. When he later showed disrespect to Nityānanda Prabhu, the village was attacked the next day and he and his family were killed.
